instruction: When replying to emails, I want the reply text to appear above the quoted message instead of below it. Could you help me configure Thunderbird to place my replies at the top?

metadata.explanation: Task requires configuring Thunderbird to place replies above quoted text by setting mail.identity.id1.reply_on_top to 1. This is checked in the prefs.js file after closing Thunderbird to ensure the setting persists.
metadata.verification: Checked existing Thunderbird prefs.js - mail.identity.id1.reply_on_top is currently set to 1 (line 66). Task asks to enable 'reply on top' which sets this value to 1.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to place replies above quoted text
Getter extracts the correct state: fetches prefs.js from correct VM path after Thunderbird is closed
Metric check_thunderbird_prefs correctly parses prefs.js and checks mail.identity.id1.reply_on_top == 1
Complete coverage: the single preference mail.identity.id1.reply_on_top fully determines reply positioning
Proper state management: postconfig closes Thunderbird to ensure prefs.js is written to disk before verification
Correct metric parameter handling: check_thunderbird_prefs receives rules dict directly and correctly accesses rule.get('expect') without trying to access rule.get('rules') or rule.get('type')
Semantically correct expected value: value 1 correctly represents 'reply on top' enabled in Thunderbird
Data flow is correct: VM file getter -> file path -> metric parses file and checks preference value

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
